description: Labeled evaluation corpus for the Prompt Injection Firewall. Each entry has 'text', a 'category' (one of the 9 attack types, or 'benign'), and 'expect' ('detect' for attacks, 'allow' for benign). Benign entries deliberately include near-misses that reuse attack trigger words in legitimate contexts to measure false positives.
